# Estrela Photography

> Javier Estrela is a professional photographer based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, specializing in visual content for artists: press kits (EPK), portfolios, promo sessions and live-show coverage for musicians, DJs and performers. Bookings via WhatsApp +971 58 532 4519 or info@estrela.photo.

## Services and prices (AED, no hidden fees)

- Artist Promo Session — AED 1,300: up to 2-hour shoot, 10 edited photos, full shoot on USB, delivered within 72 hours.
- Artist Portfolio — AED 1,500: up to 2-hour shoot, 15 edited photos, full shoot on USB, delivered within 72 hours. Most popular option.
- EPK & Live Show — from AED 6,500: up to 3-hour shoot, combo of photos and video, full press-kit visual assets, delivered within 1 week.
- Add-ons: 5 extra edited photos AED 500 · 1 extra hour AED 500 · video from AED 1,500.

## Key facts

- Location: Dubai, UAE. Shoots across the Emirates: studios, clubs and live venues, rooftops, urban locations, desert.
- Specialty: live performance and artist branding photography. "I don't just take photos; I build your brand."
- Delivery: 72 hours for photo sessions; 1 week for EPK packages.
- Booking: WhatsApp +971 58 532 4519 (fastest), contact form at https://estrela.photo/, or info@estrela.photo.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/estrelaphotography

## Who it's for

Musicians, bands, DJs, singers and performers in Dubai and the UAE who need professional photos for promoters, venues, labels, streaming profiles and social media.
